description: SAPOS® - Hochpräziser Echtzeit-Positionierungs-Service (SAPOS® -HEPS) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by lgln-geodaten.niedersachsen.de. With the networked SAPOS® HEPS, a real-time positioning accuracy of 1-2 centimeters (location) or 2-3 centimeters (ellipsoidal height) can be realized. The correction data derived from carrier phase measurements are transmitted over the Internet (NTRIP method) in the standardized RTCM format every 1 second. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "SAPOS® - High-precision real-time positioning service (SAPOS® -HEPS)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Raumbezug, opendata, Satellitenpositionierung, Bremen, SAPOS, Niedersachsen. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/conditionsUnknown). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
